category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: A vulnerability management plan is developed and implemented.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-5 (Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning), RA-5(2) (Update Vulnerabilities), SI-2 (Flaw Remediation)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.8 (Management of technical vulnerabilities)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.RA-08 (vulnerability status monitored)
implementation_examples: Develop and implement a vulnerability-management plan covering identification (intelligence sources, scanning), prioritisation (risk-based), remediation (patch/configure), and confirmation (re-scan)
Track vulnerabilities through closure and report key metrics (MTTR) to leadership
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a vulnerability-management plan exists
Determine whether identification, prioritisation, remediation, and confirmation steps are executed
Determine whether third-party components are in scope
Determine whether metrics are tracked and reported
